sections.title: Special Topics in STEM: Forensic Science
sections.description: The MCS Special Topics course fulfills the elective requirement for graduation from the Master of Chemical Sciences program or may be taken by other graduate students. The course allows for a special title and focus, which may be different from section to section. This course will allow for topics and courses to be offered to students to fill a need in a skill set or introduce a new course topic to gauge interest. The special topic will be scholarly in scope, well-researched, organized and professional, and that contributes to the knowledge base in chemistry or improves practice in the science.
